purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical receipt (レセプト) billing system - hospital ward management (病棟管理) subsystem within system administration information settings (システム管理情報設定)
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It handles hospital ward management (病棟管理) configuration within the system administration information settings subsystem. It manages ward lists, nursing care codes, hospitalization classifications, and related medical fee calculation settings including H28/H30 (Heisei 28/30 year) medical fee revision codes.

notable_features: 35 COPY statements for modular copybook inclusion
Japanese UTF-8 comments and data names
REDEFINES used extensively for code table overlays
OCCURS tables for medical procedure codes
S9(9) BINARY fields for state management
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
High PERFORM count (1014) indicating structured procedural logic
Medical fee revision constants for H28/H30 (2016/2018 reforms)
verdict.notes: Source is truncated to first 16000 chars of a ~580KB file. The program is clearly part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system used widely in Japanese clinics. GnuCOBOL dialect confirmed by ORCA project context. Fixed format with max line length 74 consistent with standard COBOL column layout.
